cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(reverie_signal_admission_state C ASM)
find_package(DynamoRIO REQUIRED)
add_library(signal_admission_state_client SHARED client.c clobber.S)
configure_DynamoRIO_client(signal_admission_state_client)
use_DynamoRIO_extension(signal_admission_state_client drmgr)
target_compile_options(signal_admission_state_client PRIVATE -Werror=implicit-function-declaration)
add_executable(signal_admission_state_guest guest.c probe.S clobber.S)
target_compile_options(signal_admission_state_guest PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-stack-protector)
target_link_options(signal_admission_state_guest PRIVATE -rdynamic)
target_link_libraries(signal_admission_state_guest PRIVATE pthread)

add_library(signal_capture_client SHARED EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL capture_client.c)
configure_DynamoRIO_client(signal_capture_client)
use_DynamoRIO_extension(signal_capture_client drmgr)
target_compile_options(signal_capture_client PRIVATE -Werror=implicit-function-declaration)
add_executable(signal_capture_guest EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL capture_guest.c)
target_compile_options(signal_capture_guest PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-stack-protector)
target_link_options(signal_capture_guest PRIVATE -rdynamic)

# Separate real publication-wait finalizer contract; no existing target changes.
add_library(signal_wait_finalizer_client SHARED EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL wait_finalizer_client.c)
configure_DynamoRIO_client(signal_wait_finalizer_client)
use_DynamoRIO_extension(signal_wait_finalizer_client drmgr)
target_compile_options(signal_wait_finalizer_client PRIVATE -Werror=implicit-function-declaration)
add_executable(signal_wait_finalizer_guest EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL wait_finalizer_guest.c)
target_compile_options(signal_wait_finalizer_guest PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fno-stack-protector)
target_link_options(signal_wait_finalizer_guest PRIVATE -rdynamic)
